privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introBody: This Privacy Policy explains how Moore World Wide Enterprises, LLC operates the Salon marketplace platform and processes personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other applicable data protection laws.
privacy.accountDataBody: When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, authentication provider information, and marketplace role selection (entertainer/venue operator).
privacy.profileDataBody: Approved members provide venue or entertainer profile data including descriptions, locations, capacity, production resources, pricing, contact methods, portfolio items, and technical requirements.
privacy.bookingDataBody: We record applications, direct requests, agreed terms, calendar availability, hold status, agreement generation metadata, signature events, deposit status records, and audit trails of booking lifecycle changes.
privacy.technicalDataBody: We automatically collect IP addresses, browser type, device information, cookies, session data, and usage analytics to operate and improve the service.
privacy.contractBasisBody: Processing is necessary to provide the marketplace services you've requested.
privacy.legitimateInterestBody: We process data to prevent fraud, ensure platform security, and improve our services.
privacy.consentBasisBody: For optional analytics and marketing cookies, we rely on your explicit consent.
privacy.legalObligationBody: We process data to comply with legal requirements, including tax and financial record-keeping obligations.
privacy.useProvideServices: Provide and maintain the Salon marketplace platform
privacy.useManageAccounts: Manage accounts, approval states, and role-based access control
privacy.useFacilitateBookings: Facilitate bookings, calendar coordination, and contact unlocking
privacy.usePreventFraud: Prevent fraud, abuse, and security incidents
privacy.useComply: Comply with legal obligations and respond to lawful requests
privacy.useImprove: Improve platform features and user experience
privacy.useCommunicate: Communicate service updates, booking notifications, and operational messages
privacy.sharingBody: We do not sell personal data. We share data only in these limited circumstances:
privacy.sharingApprovedMembersBody: Role-segregated discovery surfaces share approved profile data with other approved members. Contact details are revealed only after shortlist or accepted direct request.
privacy.sharingServiceProvidersBody: We engage sub-processors to provide hosting, database, authentication, file storage, and operational services under data processing agreements.
privacy.sharingLegalBody: We may disclose data to comply with legal obligations, enforce our terms, or protect rights and safety.
privacy.subProcessorsLink: View our complete list of sub-processors at
privacy.internationalTransfersBody: Salon operates with infrastructure providers based in the United States and Europe. Data transfers outside the European Economic Area (EEA) are protected by Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), adequacy decisions, or equivalent safeguards as required by GDPR Article 46.
privacy.retentionBody: We retain personal data for as long as necessary to provide services, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. Approved profiles and booking records are retained for operational and legal record-keeping purposes. Upon account closure, we will delete or anonymize data in accordance with applicable retention schedules and legal requirements.
privacy.rightAccessBody: Request a copy of personal data we hold about you.
privacy.rightRectificationBody: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
privacy.rightErasureBody: Request deletion of your personal data under certain circumstances.
privacy.rightRestrictionBody: Request limitation of processing under certain conditions.
privacy.rightPortabilityBody: Receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format.
privacy.rightObjectBody: Object to processing based on legitimate interests or direct marketing.
privacy.rightWithdrawBody: Withdraw consent for processing based on consent at any time.
privacy.rightComplainBody: File a complaint with your local data protection supervisory authority.
privacy.exerciseRights: To exercise these rights, contact us at hello@moorewwe.com. We will respond within one month of receiving a valid request.
privacy.securityBody: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures including encryption in transit (TLS), encrypted storage, access controls, security monitoring, regular security assessments, and incident response procedures. However, no system is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.cookiesBody: We use cookies and similar technologies for authentication, preferences, analytics, and security.
privacy.childrenBody: Salon is not intended for individuals under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If we become aware of such collection, we will delete the data promptly.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated via email or prominent notice on the platform. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy inquiries, data subject requests, or to exercise your rights, contact us at:

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.introBody: By accessing or using the Salon marketplace platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, you may not use the service.
terms.serviceDescriptionBody: Salon is a private, curated B2B marketplace connecting Berlin venues with small-format entertainers. The platform facilitates discovery, protected contact exchange, booking terms negotiation, calendar coordination, and agreement generation. Salon is a coordination marketplace, not a payment processor, escrow service, legal advisor, or event organizer.
terms.accountReq2: Provide accurate and complete registration information
terms.accountReq3: Maintain the security of your account credentials
terms.accountReq4: Notify us immediately of any unauthorized access
terms.approvalProcessBody: Access to private marketplace features requires staff approval. We review applications manually and may approve, request changes, or decline at our discretion. Approval does not constitute verification of legal, tax, insurance, safety, or artistic qualifications.
terms.userObligation1: Provide truthful and accurate profile information
terms.userObligation3: Respond to booking requests and applications in good faith
terms.userObligation4: Comply with agreed booking terms and agreements
terms.userObligation5: Respect intellectual property rights of other members
terms.userObligation6: Use the platform only for legitimate booking coordination
terms.bookingsBody: Salon facilitates booking terms negotiation and agreement generation. Bookings are confirmed when both parties sign the generated agreement. German agreement text is controlling; English is a convenience translation. Salon is not a party to booking agreements and does not guarantee performance, payment, or dispute resolution.
terms.paymentsBody: Salon does not currently process payments, hold deposits, or act as an escrow agent. Payment terms are negotiated directly between venues and entertainers. Any future payment features will be subject to separate terms and fee schedules.
terms.intellectualPropertyBody: The Salon platform, including its design, code, trademarks, and content, is owned by Moore World Wide Enterprises, LLC. Users retain ownership of their submitted content but grant us a limited license to display and operate the platform. You may not copy, modify, distribute, or create derivative works of platform elements without authorization.
terms.prohibited1: Impersonate others or provide false information
terms.prohibited2: Harass, abuse, or threaten other members
terms.prohibited3: Circumvent platform fees or contact privacy protections
terms.prohibited4: Scrape, data mine, or automate access without permission
terms.prohibited5: Upload malicious code, viruses, or harmful content
terms.prohibited6: Violate applicable laws or third-party rights
terms.prohibited7: Interfere with platform security or integrity
terms.suspensionBody: We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms, engage in prohibited conduct, or pose risks to the platform or members. Upon termination, your access to private marketplace features will be revoked, but existing booking records and audit trails will be preserved for operational and legal purposes.
terms.disclaimersBody: Salon is provided 'as is' without warranties of any kind, express or implied. We do not warrant that the service will be uninterrupted, error-free, or secure. We do not verify the accuracy of member profiles, the performance of entertainers, the suitability of venues, or the outcome of bookings. Use the platform at your own risk.
terms.limitationLiabilityBody: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Moore World Wide Enterprises, LLC shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of Salon. Our total liability shall not exceed the fees paid by you, if any, in the twelve months preceding the claim.
terms.indemnificationBody: You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Moore World Wide Enterprises, LLC from claims, damages, liabilities, and expenses arising from your use of the platform, violation of these terms, or infringement of third-party rights.
terms.dataProtectionBody: Processing of personal data is governed by our
terms.terminationBody: You may close your account at any time by contacting us. We may terminate or suspend access immediately for violations of these terms. Provisions regarding intellectual property, disclaimers, limitation of liability, and indemnification survive termination.
terms.governingLawBody: These Terms are governed by the laws of the State of Texas, United States. Disputes shall be resolved in the state or federal courts located in Brazos County, Texas, unless mandatory consumer protection laws require otherwise.
terms.changesBody: We may modify these Terms from time to time. Material changes will be communicated via email or prominent platform notice. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
terms.contactBody: For questions about these Terms, contact us at:

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.whatAreCookiesBody: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help websites remember your preferences, authenticate your identity, and understand how you use the service.
cookiePolicy.howWeUseBody: Salon uses cookies for essential functionality, security, analytics, and user experience improvements. You can control non-essential cookies through our cookie consent banner.

dpa.title: Data Processing Agreement
dpa.introBody: This Data Processing Agreement (DPA) governs the processing of personal data by Moore World Wide Enterprises, LLC (Data Processor) on behalf of Salon marketplace users (Data Controllers) in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable data protection laws.
dpa.controllerDefinition: The entity (venue operator or entertainer) that determines the purposes and means of processing personal data.
dpa.processorDefinition: Moore World Wide Enterprises, LLC, which processes personal data on behalf of the Controller.
dpa.dataSubjectDefinition: The identified or identifiable natural person whose personal data is processed.
dpa.personalDataDefinition: Any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person as defined by GDPR Article 4(1).
dpa.scopeBody: This DPA applies to the processing of personal data necessary to provide Salon marketplace services, including:
dpa.scopeItem1: Profile data of entertainers and venue operators
dpa.instructionsBody: The Processor shall process personal data only on documented instructions from the Controller, including transfers of personal data to third countries or international organizations, unless required by EU or Member State law. The Processor shall immediately inform the Controller if instructions violate GDPR or other data protection provisions.
dpa.securityBody: The Processor implements appropriate technical and organizational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk, including:
dpa.securityMeasure1: Encryption of personal data in transit and at rest
dpa.securityMeasure3: Regular security assessments and penetration testing
dpa.securityMeasure5: Staff training on data protection and security
dpa.subProcessorsBody: The Processor engages sub-processors to assist in providing services. The Controller consents to the use of sub-processors listed on our Sub-processors page. The Processor shall notify the Controller of any intended changes concerning addition or replacement of sub-processors at least 30 days in advance.
dpa.subProcessorsLink: View the complete list of sub-processors:
dpa.dataSubjectRightsBody: The Processor shall assist the Controller in fulfilling obligations to respond to data subject requests exercising their rights under GDPR, including:
dpa.dataBreachBody: The Processor shall notify the Controller without undue delay and within 72 hours of becoming aware of a personal data breach affecting the Controller's data. The notification shall include available information about the nature of the breach, affected data categories and subjects, likely consequences, and measures taken or proposed.
dpa.dataRetentionBody: The Processor shall retain personal data only for as long as necessary to provide services or as required by law. Upon termination of services or upon Controller request, the Processor shall delete or return all personal data and delete existing copies unless storage is required by applicable law.
dpa.dataTransferBody: Where processing involves transfer of personal data outside the European Economic Area (EEA), the Processor shall ensure such transfers are protected by appropriate safeguards including Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), adequacy decisions, or other mechanisms approved under GDPR Chapter V.
dpa.auditBody: The Controller has the right to audit the Processor's compliance with this DPA and GDPR obligations. The Processor shall make available all information necessary to demonstrate compliance and allow for and contribute to audits, including inspections, conducted by the Controller or an auditor mandated by the Controller upon reasonable notice.
dpa.terminationBody: This DPA remains in effect for as long as the Processor processes personal data on behalf of the Controller. Upon termination, the Processor shall cease all processing, delete or return all personal data, and delete existing copies unless retention is required by law.
dpa.contactBody: For questions about this DPA or data protection matters, contact:

subProcessors.title: List of Sub-processors
subProcessors.introBody: This page lists all third-party sub-processors engaged by Moore World Wide Enterprises, LLC to process personal data on behalf of Salon marketplace users. We carefully select sub-processors that maintain high standards of data protection and security.
subProcessors.vercelPurpose: Hosting, CDN, serverless functions, edge computing, and file storage infrastructure
subProcessors.vercelLocation: United States and global edge network
subProcessors.vercelSafeguards: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR-compliant DPA
subProcessors.neonPurpose: Serverless PostgreSQL database hosting and management
subProcessors.neonSafeguards: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), SOC 2 Type II, GDPR-compliant DPA
subProcessors.googlePurpose: Optional analytics (Google Analytics) and authentication provider (Google OAuth) when enabled
subProcessors.googleSafeguards: EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, Standard Contractual Clauses, GDPR-compliant DPA
subProcessors.microsoftSafeguards: EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, Standard Contractual Clauses, ISO 27001, SOC 2
subProcessors.githubSafeguards: Standard Contractual Clauses, SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR-compliant practices
subProcessors.updatesBody: We will notify users at least 30 days in advance of adding or replacing sub-processors. Notification will be provided via email and a notice on this page. Users may object to a new sub-processor within 30 days of notification.
subProcessors.contactBody: For questions about our sub-processors or data processing practices, contact us at
